messages:
mira (Product): Quick design review request — Trace Viewer drilldown. mira (Product): Two things we need to settle before the next release: - placement + copy for the Download/Export action in the request drawer - how collapsed stackframe rows are announced to screen readers (aria-live flow) kate (Design): I sketched three placements: top toolbar (current), inline row action, and sticky footer. top toolbar is compact but easy to miss for scanning. kate (Design): Inline row action feels discoverable for power users (right-aligned), but increases visual noise for long stacks. ben (Eng): From runtime side, inline export triggers a backend job and returns a link. That flow is easier to attach to a specific span if the button is per-frame. ben (Eng): technically fine either way. perf-wise top toolbar avoids N extra buttons in large traces. oscar (A11y): For SR users, consistent focus order is key. If we add per-frame buttons, they must be tabbable but skipped by default via roving focus pattern. oscar (A11y): Collapsed frames: propose announcing like: "3 stack frames collapsed. Press enter to expand." Use aria-live="polite" on the collapsible summary. kate (Design): Wording options for the collapse affordance: "3 frames collapsed — expand" vs "3 collapsed frames (enter to expand)". Prefer shorter: "3 frames collapsed" with an accessible hint on focus. lina (SRE): One concern: when export is tied to a frame, the exported bundle should include correlation ids and request metadata. Ben — can we include that automatically? ben (Eng): yes — we'll attach corr_id + trace_id + timestamp to every per-frame export. For toolbar export we'll include the whole request context. mira (Product): Copy for the main export button — current placeholder "Download trace". Thoughts on "Download trace (with raw events)" vs "Export trace bundle"? kate (Design): "Export trace bundle" reads more technical. For PM/eng customers, OK. For general users, "Download trace" is clearer. Maybe contextual: toolbar says "Download trace" and per-frame says "Export frame". oscar (A11y): Also add visible focus ring and ensure the button has aria-label that includes the trace id when it's frame-specific: e.g., aria-label="Export frame for span 0x3a — includes trace ID 8f7a". kate (Design): UI placement idea: sticky footer only shows when user scrolls past the header; reduces clutter. On mobile small screens, move export into the overflow menu. lina (SRE): Alerting / telemetry: add a metric when users click per-frame export vs global download so we can see which is used. mira (Product): Good call. Ben — add telemetry event names? ben (Eng): will add "trace.export.global" and "trace.export.frame". Also include export_format and size. oscar (A11y): Implementation note: avoid using aria-hidden on the collapsed rows; rely on CSS and aria-expanded toggles. When expanding, set focus to the first visible frame content. kate (Design): small copy tweak for correlation pill: currently "corr: 1234" -> prefer full label "Correlation ID: 1234" for clarity. Keep the pill compact but add a tooltip with copy action. mira (Product): Agree. Tooltip text: "Copy correlation ID" and confirmation toast: "Copied correlation ID to clipboard". ben (Eng): We'll add a small copy button. For keyboard: support Ctrl+C when pill focused as well. oscar (A11y): Toasts must be announced by aria-live="assertive" so keyboard users know copy succeeded. kate (Design): One more UX nit: when a user expands a collapsed group, we should animate height only, avoid moving surrounding content abruptly. Also provide a reduced-motion preference. lina (SRE): Edge case: extremely large traces (10k frames) — per-frame buttons would be many DOM nodes. Consider virtualization + render buttons on hover only. ben (Eng): we'll virtualize the list and render per-frame actions lazily on hover/focus. That satisfies perf and a11y if we keep keyboard focusable placeholders. mira (Product): Next steps: Kate to update mock with sticky footer + inline variant, Oscar to write a short a11y doc (3 bullets), Ben to add telemetry & export payload spec, Lina to add perf constraints. I'll collate and we sync Thurs. kate (Design): Will drop two mocks in Figma by EOD and label the states. oscar (A11y): Will draft the aria annotations and sample snippet: /* snippet for polite announce */
3 frames collapsed
 oscar (A11y): Also recommend role="button" + tabindex="0" on the collapse toggle, and visible focus styles. ben (Eng): copying the export payload fields: trace_id, span_id (if frame), corr_id, timestamp, environment, format. Will post JSON sample in thread. mira (Product): Thanks all — this is a really useful set of constraints. :thumbsup: kate (Design): :eyes: will incorporate. aria-bot: Reminder: accessibility checklist item added to this thread: "collapse announcement" and "export button labeling". mira (Product): tagging follow-ups: @kate (Design) @oscar (A11y) @ben (Eng) @lina (SRE) — see you on Thu sync.
